description: Identify music in a user-attached album cover, several covers or shelf spines, vinyl/CD label, tracklist screenshot or concert poster. Returns observed text, uncertain details, song identities or album release choices for review. Does not generate a show, save a file or start playback. For a tracklist, use confirmed tracks with make_playable experience=media. For an album, confirm the release before making an album story. For a poster, confirm the artists and ask what listening experience is wanted. Cover artwork alone does not establish a physical pressing or exact edition. If an attachment URL expires, ask for the file again rather than inferring its contents.
name: identify_image
title: Identify music in an image
